name: github-pages-deploy
description: Deploy static sites to GitHub Pages from Codex using the GitHub REST API.

interface.shortDescription: Publish static sites to GitHub Pages.
interface.longDescription: Adds a Codex skill for uploading local static website files to GitHub, enabling GitHub Pages, waiting for deployment, and returning the published URL without requiring local git or gh.
defaultPrompt: Deploy this static site to GitHub Pages.
Upload these files to GitHub and return the Pages URL.
